criterion_text: Server-embedded, Agent-embedded and Standalone MCP clients invoke the same fixture Tool against explicitly named owning Agents; offline, wrong Agent, unknown Session and stale manifest fail closed without cross-Agent fallback.

verifiers.summary: One fixture contribution was discoverable and executable by the named owner across Server, Standalone and Agent surfaces; incompatible and stale manifests were refused while the last valid generation stayed live.

evidence.value: exact SHA ce2a353df7734cffcd8663ea33dd4df89b4a476d: a fixture Extension Tool advertised by one Agent was listed and invoked through Server-embedded and Standalone MCP hosts against the explicitly named owning Agent, and the Server brokered exactly one call to that Agent

exact SHA ce2a353df7734cffcd8663ea33dd4df89b4a476d: a wrong Agent, an unknown owner-specific Session, an offline owner, a conflicting same-name contract and an unsupported manifest version each failed closed (not_found/unavailable) with no cross-Agent fallback; the capability stayed listed while its owner was offline
exact SHA ce2a353df7734cffcd8663ea33dd4df89b4a476d: the owning Agent executed the same contributed Tool on its direct P2P surface and refused a foreign agent_id and an unadvertised Tool
